response.value: I’ll add the lamp-specific glow overlays to the three existing hero buttons, keeping their current placement, parallax, and carousel behavior intact.

resultDetails.input: await page.reload(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); const lamps = await page.locator('[data-lamp]').evaluateAll(nodes => nodes.map(lamp => ({type: lamp.dataset.lampType, overlayPaths: lamp.querySelectorAll('svg .lamp-light').length, disabled: lamp.disabled, label: lamp.getAttribute('aria-label')}))); await page.locator('[data-lamp-type="1"]').click(); const clicked = await page.locator('[data-lamp-type="1"]').evaluate(lamp => ({pressed: lamp.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), lit: lamp.classList.contains('is-lit'), label: lamp.getAttribute('aria-label')})); return {lamps, clicked};

resultDetails.input: const results = []; for (const type of ['1','2','3']) { const lamp = page.locator(`[data-lamp-type="${type}"]`); await lamp.click(); const on = await lamp.evaluate(node => ({pressed: node.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), pathOpacity: getComputedStyle(node.querySelector('.lamp-light')).opacity, fill: getComputedStyle(node.querySelector('.lamp-light')).fill, disabled: node.disabled})); await lamp.click(); const off = await lamp.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); results.push({type, on, off}); } return results;
